resources.string: On your computer, open Settings → Remote access and copy the address shown there, or scan the pairing QR code and paste the link.

• Tailscale (works anywhere): turn Tailscale on on this phone, then https://your-pc.tailXXXX.ts.net\n• Your Cloudflare address: https://nexus.example.com\n• Same Wi-Fi only: http://192.168.x.x:7823 (not encrypted)
Nothing to paste. Copy the address or the QR link first.
Enter an address starting with https:// or http://
This is a Tailscale address: open the Tailscale app on this phone and make sure it is connected (same account as the computer). On the computer, Tailscale must be on and \"tailscale serve\" set up.
This local address only works on the same Wi-Fi as the computer, with remote access on and \"Reachable from other devices on my network\" enabled.
Connected: approvals and replies arrive here
This phone was disconnected from the assistant. Open the app to pair again.
